mapper.select: SELECT C.NR_ITEM_NM || '(' || B.BDSR_RGN_ETC_CNTE || ')' AS region, A.INPT_DTM AS writingDateTime, 'Stage ' || A.BDSR_STEP_CTG_CD as stage, A.BDSR_SZ_WDTH_VAL::float || '/' || A.BDSR_SZ_VLIN_VAL::float || '/' || A.BDSR_SZ_DPTH_VAL::float as size, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003001' AND Z.COMN_CD = A.BDSR_REC_DRSS_IMPL_TP_CD) as dressingAction, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0003000' AND Z.COMN_CD = D.BDSR_REC_DRSS_MTHD_CD) as dressingMethod, (SELECT Z.COMN_CD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCCCCSTE Z WHERE Z.COMN_GRP_CD = 'N0000286' AND Z.COMN_CD = E.BDSR_REC_DRSS_KND_CD) as dressingKind, (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_PLWK_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.FSR_STF_NO) as writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRNNRPCD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPAD B ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = B.BDSR_REC_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON B.BDSR_RGN_NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPDE D ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = D.BDSR_REC_ID AND A.INPT_DTM = D.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = D.WRT_SEQ INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRPFE E ON A.BDSR_REC_ID = E.BDSR_REC_ID AND A.INPT_DTM = E.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = E.WRT_SEQ WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM::DATE = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.BDSR_REC_ID

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID, C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID) || '.' || D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_NM || ' : ' || C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_NM || ' (' || C.ITEM_WVAL_VAL::FLOAT || ') ' AS detailText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBEE B ON A.PT_NO = B.PT_NO AND A.INPT_DTM = B.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = B.WRT_SEQ INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBCD C ON B.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID = C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBBD D ON C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID AND D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID NOT IN (5623400, 5623430) WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT '총점 : ' || B.BDSR_DOR_CTG_GRP_NM || ' (' || A.BDSR_DOR_ASSM_SCR::FLOAT || ')' AS totalText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBDC B ON A.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ID = B.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ID AND A.BDSR_DOR_CTG_GRP_CD = B.BDSR_DOR_CTG_GRP_CD AND A.INPT_DTM::DATE BETWEEN B.AVL_STR_DTM AND B.AVL_END_DTM WHERE A. PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId}

SELECT C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_NM AS preventText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBEE B ON A.PT_NO = B.PT_NO AND A.INPT_DTM = B.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = B.WRT_SEQ INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBCD C ON B.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID = C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBBD D ON C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID AND D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = 5623400 WHERE A. PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT '욕창유무 : ' || C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_NM AS bedsoreText FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBEE B ON A.PT_NO = B.PT_NO AND A.INPT_DTM = B.INPT_DTM AND A.WRT_SEQ = B.WRT_SEQ INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBCD C ON B.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID = C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOPPCBBD D ON C.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID AND D.BDSR_DOR_ASTL_CTG_ID = 5623430 WHERE A. PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId} ORDER BY D.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ
SELECT B.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MOPPCBED A INNER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD B ON A.FSR_STF_NO = B.STF_NO WHERE A.PT_NO || '_' || A.INPT_DTM || '_' || A.WRT_SEQ = #{keyId}
